articles.title: Assembly Hall of Shame
articles.summary: Assembly Hall of Shame takes the opposite approach to instruction-level optimization, focusing on searching for the absolute floor of single-instruction performance by starving high-latency components with tight reads and non-posted transactions. The strategy involves loading a specific region in the PCIe fabric using fxrstor64, then hammering against other high-latency locations with tight 4-byte reads. This approach prioritizes instruction-level optimization over traditional performance-focused techniques like branch prediction and loop unrolling.
